newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka '97 budget deficit at 98 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka '97 budget deficit at 98 bln rupees.

text.p: Sri Lanka's budget deficit for calendar 1997 will be 98 billion rupees compared to the revised estimate of 97.6 billion rupees this year, Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris told parliament.
"The emerging budget deficit for 1997 is too high," Peiris told parliament as he presented the state budget for calendar 1997.
The budget has set spending at 283.3 billion rupees, against 185.7 billion rupees in revenues.
